dominant_strengths: Faithful Apple system language — SF typography, generous whitespace, and product-forward photography feel native and trustworthy.
Restrained palette lets product hero imagery carry color, with consistent blue CTA accents anchoring interaction.
Carousel rhythm with color dots, paired Learn more/Buy actions, and pricing hierarchy show disciplined component craft.
dominant_weaknesses: Pure replication of Apple.com offers near-zero originality — innovation and distinctiveness scores collapse against the brief.
Reflective payoff is weak: headline 'Take a closer look' floats without supporting narrative tension or surprise.
Carousel arrows are small and visually disconnected from the cards, weakening behavioral affordance and scan flow.
fix_priorities: Introduce a distinguishing point of view — comparison overlay, spec scrubber, or motion-driven storytelling — beyond mimicry.
Strengthen carousel controls: larger hit targets, progress indicator, and clearer relationship to the active card.
Tighten vertical rhythm between price line and CTA pair so each card reads as one confident block.
Add a subtle reflective hook in the section header to earn the 'closer look' transition.
rationale.norman_balance: Strong visceral and competent behavioral execution, but reflective layer is thin because the work is derivative rather than authored.
rationale.intent_fit: It executes an Apple iPhone scroll faithfully, satisfying the literal brief while adding little design value of its own.
